Vesthimmerlands is a Danish municipality (*kommune*) whose healthcare quality metrics are documented in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. Specifically, Vesthimmerlands is included in the report's detailed municipal breakdown for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes (*apopleksi*) among atrial fibrillation patients using anticoagulant treatment, utilizing data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. 

On page 95 of the report, Vesthimmerlands is listed with specific statistical outcomes: the municipality recorded 6 events out of 887 patients (with a rate of 0.7 and a confidence interval of 0.2–1.5) and 6 out of 912 patients in a secondary metric [^src1]. This inclusion in the granular, 98-municipality benchmarking data highlights Vesthimmerlands' role in the national framework for local clinical quality development and cross-regional comparison [^src1]. 

Because the extracted corpus only contains a single tabular mention of Vesthimmerlands, no further relationships, distinct claims, or timeline events are available for this entity, and no related entity pages are currently linked in the wiki.
